description: § 1250(a), (b)(1); Form 4797 line 26: § 1250 property with $100,000 of depreciation, $90,000 of it in excess of straight line (e.g. a special allowance), sold for $80,000 with a $100,000 cost: gain $80,000, all ordinary (the smaller of the gain or the additional depreciation, at 100%), and no unrecaptured § 1250 gain left.
